html:
Greetings, Agents. 


This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

These tiny yet powerful Super Heroes 
have entered the microscopic and dangerous Quantum Realm!
The theme of the February update is inspired by
Marvel Studios' Ant-Man and The Wasp: Quantumania.

 

Tier-4 Advancement and a new Uniform for Ant-Man,
Potential Transcendence and a new Uniform for Wasp,
and the new Super Hero Cassie Lang have been added,
and the Ant-Man family are now ready to explore the Quantum Realm.

 

The Ant-Man family will have to challenge M.O.D.O.K. 
who has become even stronger through Tier-3 Advancement and the new Uniform.
They would also have to challenge a powerful enemy 
at the new Legendary Battle: Quantum Conquest.

 

We have also prepared various improvements and changes such as changes in Guided Quest 
and the increase of EXP that can be acquired when using Character EXP Chips, 

so please check the details below.

 


▣ One New Hero

 

Cassie Lang inspired by <Ant-Man and The Wasp: Quantumania> has been added.
She will begin her journey to become a Super Hero in the Quantum Realm.
* The hero skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

[2/21 (Tue) 5:21 (UTC+0), 2/20 (Mon) 21:21 (PST) added]
The Increases all Basic Attacks stat of the 5th active skill has been fixed.
Before: 50% at Lv. 6
After: 55% at Lv. 6

 

 

 

▣ Three New Uniforms


Three new costumes inspired by Ant-Man and The Wasp: Quantumania have been added.
Check out the abilities of Ant-Man <Ant-Man and The Wasp: Quantumania>, 
Wasp <Ant-Man and The Wasp: Quantumania>, and M.O.D.O.K.<Ant-Man and The Wasp: Quantumania>.
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats. (Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)
* The three new uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <February Update Celebration Event>, 
and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room after the event.

 

 

 

 


▣ M.O.D.O.K. Tier-3

 

M.O.D.O.K. is now available for Tier-3 Advancement.
M.O.D.O.K. now has the power to fulfill the purpose of his design.

 

[2/16 (Thu) 3:15 (UTC+0), 2/15 (Wed) 19:15 (PST) added]

The Tier-3 Skill effect of M.O.D.O.K. being wrongly written has been fixed.

We apologize for any inconvenience.
Before: Energy Damage 180% of Energy Attack / Additional 75 Mind Damage
After: Mind Damage 180% of Energy Attack / Additional 75 Mind Damage

 

 

 

 

▣ Ant-Man Tier-4

 

Ant-Man is now available for Tier-4 Advancement.
Check out the looks of Ant-Man who has become enlarged by upgrading his Pym Particles.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ Wasp, Giant-Man Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential

 

Through the February Update, Wasp and Giant-Man 

have acquired Potential Awakening & Transcendence!
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 


▣ Legendary Battle: Quantum Conquest Release


Participate in the Legendary Battle inspired by 
Ant-Man and The Wasp: Quantumania and acquire various rewards.
​
1. Acquire Cassie Lang as 1★ when entering the stage <Stinging Debut>.
- The reward can only be acquired once upon first clearing when Cassie Lang is not possessed.​

 

 

2. Agents can enjoy Extreme Mode after purchasing the product.
​ 

- Legendary Battle Extreme Mode effects will apply immediately after purchase,
so please take note that Crystal refunds will not be available.
- Extreme Mode can be played continuously when purchasing the Legendary Battle Extreme Mode once.
​
3. The Special Offers product will be shown for Agents who meet certain conditions.
​ 


​4. The Normal Mode / Extreme Mode of the new Legendary Battle has three stages each.
Bonus rewards will be given when completing specific missions.

 

 

* The bonus rewards can be acquired when clearing the challenges.

 

 

▣ Guided Quest Changes


The Guided Quest has been changed.
Upgrade your heroes more quickly with the shortened process!


1. The progress count for Guided Quest has been changed.
Before: Clear Tier-2 Guided Quest 10 times → Clear Tier-3 Guided Quest one time  → end of Guided Quest
After: Clear Tier-2 Guided Quest 3 times → Clear Tier-3 Guided Quest one time (can be progressed twice)
- Tier-2 Guided Quest can be progressed 6 times, and Tier-3 Guided Quest can be progressed 2 times!
* Guided Quest that has begun before the February update will not be reset.
* The Tier-3 Guided Quest can be progressed once after completing the Tier-2 Guided Quest three times.
- If you have cleared the Tier-2 Guided Quest six times or more before the update,
the Tier-3 Guided Quest will be progressed continuously for two times afterward.

* Agents who have completed the Tier-3 Guided Quest once before the update
can also progress to the Tier-3 Guided Quest once after the update.
 

 

2. The following will apply to the two Tier-3 Guided Quest-related products.
- Character Plus Pack: The benefits will be retained for two rounds when purchased once
- Special Plus Pack: Can be purchased once for each round, and the benefits will not be retained
* The Character Plus Pack and Special Plus Pack effects 
will apply immediately upon purchase and refunds may not be available.

 

 

3. The 50% discount Uniform of Guided Quest has been changed to the latest Uniform.
* If the latest Uniform was sold for a specific period, the former Uniform will be discounted.
* The Guide Quest Uniform discount will expire after completing the last mission.

Purchase the uniform at a discount price before completing the missions.

 

 

4. The number of Guided Quest missions and the clear count of some missions have been changed.
Tier-2 Guided Quest: (before) 60 missions → (after) 30 missions
Tier-3 Guided Quest: (before) 90 missions → (after) 40 missions
* Guided Quests that have been progressed will not be reset,

and the changes will apply from the next Guided Quest.


5. The unlock point of Guided Quest has been changed.
Before: After clearing Story Normal 1-1 
After: After clearing Story Normal 8-3

* The Guided Quest will not be locked when unlocked and progressed before the update.

 


▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Cassie Lang, Ant-Man, Wasp, 
M.O.D.O.K., and Giant-Man will be added after the February Update.
* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 


▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass will begin after the update.
Obtain various rewards and Special Icons with the Future Pass.

 

[Future Pass Rewards]

- Please note that Future Pass effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Legendary / Mythic Future Pass that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season 

the Pass was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season. 
Please don’t forget to check the remaining event time.
- The Mythic Pass can be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.
- Legendary and Mythic Future Passes will not be available for purchase when the season will end soon.

Please check the sale schedule in the game.

 

​New Special Icons that will represent you have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Rewards, one as a Legendary Battle reward, 
and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[February Update New Special Icon]

       

 

 

▣ One New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms inspired by Ant-Man and The Wasp: Quantumania.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. The new item Uniform Ticket has been added.
- Uniform Tickets can be used to exchange for Uniforms 

on a constant sale for a regular price of 1,750 Crystals.
* The following Uniforms may not be exchangeable.
① Uniforms that do not have a regular price of 1,750 Crystals
② Uniforms that are only sold for a certain period
③ Uniforms updated through the current version of the update (will be added in the next main update)
④ Uniforms that are currently discounted by Guided Quest
* Please check the exact list of Uniforms that can be exchanged at the Uniform Room.
* Discount benefits will not apply when using the Uniform Ticket.
* Uniform Tickets can be acquired in-game, as event rewards, or through Store purchases.

 

 

2. The bonus EXP that can be acquired from various effects and products 
when using Character EXP Chips and Uniform EXP Chips will now be displayed.
- EXP Chips won’t be used when reaching the maximum level including the bonus EXP.
- The amount of EXP acquired with Character EXP Chips has been improved.

 

 

3. Dimension Rift Summon Stones possessed can now be checked before opening a Dimension Rift.
- When selecting Dimension Rift difficulties Advanced - Mythical,
the number of Summon Stones of the selected difficulty will be shown instead of Boost Points.

 

 

4. The unlock point of Dimension Rift has been changed.
Before: After clearing Story Normal 8-3
After: After clearing Story Ultimate one time regardless of the stage

* Dimension Rift that has already been unlocked before the update will be maintained.

 

5. The former Agent Training will end and the newly changed Agent Training will be applied.
Agent Training has been changed to help Agents progress the game quickly at the beginning.
* Agent Training that was being progressed before will end automatically, 
and the new Agent Training will be newly applied.

* The current Agent Training of some Agents who will not proceed to the updated Agent Training 
will be completed and the rewards will be sent through the Inbox.
The rewards will be stored for 60 days.
 

6. The unlock point of S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy missions on hero growth & content have been changed.
Before: After clearing Story Normal 3-3 
After: After finishing Agent Training 


7. The skill effects of certain skills of the following hero will not be displayed at Giant Boss Raid.
[Target hero and skill]
Jean Grey: Tier-3 Ultimate Skill
Namor: Active Skill 5, Tier-3 Ultimate Skill


8. Agents will not be matched against teams with high growth status 

in Timeline Battle leagues Bronze and Silver.

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The issue of the hero not using the skill and charging toward Knull
in World Boss: Legend <Knull> when using specific skills has been fixed.


2. The issue of some Tier-4 skill effects being removed with Incapacitation and Cancel has been fixed.


3. The issue of the 'Enhances basic stats' text not being displayed 
at the Uniform effect of Iron Man <Back to Basics> has been fixed.


4. The issue of the 'Enhances basic stats' option 

of specific Uniforms of Iron Man not being applied at Tier-4 has been fixed.


5. The issue of the background screen being displayed abnormally 
when purchasing the Premium Hero Chest x10 under certain conditions has been fixed.


6. The issue of the end battle text being displayed 
when the Power Saving Mode is applied after Auto-Playing in certain conditions has been fixed.


7. The issue of the results screen not being displayed
when the Power Saving Mode is applied after Auto-Playing in certain conditions has been fixed.

 

8. The issue of the progress point not being updated when returning to the stage preparation screen 

from the Dimension Rift result screen has been fixed.

9. The texts of the Uniform effect of Captain America <Back to Basics> 

have been fixed to be displayed normally.


We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
